title: Odyssey Sports Tournament 2027
objectives: Showcase student talent to the wider campus
resources: Sponsor-provided prizes, registration desk and photography team

claims.claim_text: We expect approximately 136 attendees for this Sports Tournament, in line with turnout at our previous Sports Tournament events.
The requested budget of INR 31,000 is realistic and sufficient for this Sports Tournament.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
This event will become a flagship tradition for the university.
